_comment: Accepted debt for preflight Check 20 (membership-writer, ADR-077 D8).
Files outside apps/server/src/modules/identity/ that write Membership —
the row resolveViewer reads to decide what anyone may see and own.
It had three writers in two lanes, which is why half the live grants in
production carry no MEMBERSHIP audit event naming who created them
This list is EMPTY and must stay that way. It exists so the check has the
same shape as the other ratchets, not because there is debt to carry.
Adding an entry to silence a finding defeats the check; call
grantBusinessMembership or the lifecycle services in identity instead.
